## check
z=example.com&r=is+@+MX+1+smtp.google.com.%5E10+mail.example.com.&r=is+@+TXT+%22v=spf1+include:spf.protection.outlook.com+include:_spf.google.com+~all%22%5E%22v=spf1+include:spf.protection.outlook.com+~all%22&r=is+google._domainkey+TXT+%22v=DKIM1;+k=rsa;+p=MIIBIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAAOCAQ8AMIIBCgKCAQEAexampleexampleexample%22
## bind
; DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
; The records below are what the changed sets hold afterwards;
; every other record of the zone stays as it is.
$ORIGIN example.com.

; example.com MX
@ 3600 IN MX 1 smtp.google.com.
; delete: @ 3600 IN MX 10 mail.example.com.

; example.com TXT (SPF); the other TXT records of @ stay
@ 3600 IN TXT "v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com include:_spf.google.com ~all"
; delete: @ 3600 IN TXT "v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com ~all"

; google._domainkey.example.com TXT (DKIM); the other TXT records of google._domainkey stay
; replaces the DKIM record of google._domainkey
google._domainkey 3600 IN TXT "v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=MIIBIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAAOCAQ8AMIIBCgKCAQEAexampleexampleexample"

## cloudflare
#!/bin/sh
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# Needs an API token that may edit this zone's DNS records (Zone > DNS > Edit) and the zone ID
# (the zone's Overview page). Neither is written here: set both in your shell first.
: "${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN:?set CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN to your API token}"
: "${CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID:?set CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID to the zone ID of example.com}"
API="https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/$CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID/dns_records"

# 1. Change example.com MX: 10 mail.example.com. -> 1 smtp.google.com.
#    Find the record's id, then:
curl -sS "$API?type=MX&name=example.com" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"
curl -sS -X PATCH "$API/RECORD_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"type":"MX","name":"example.com","content":"smtp.google.com","priority":1,"ttl":3600}'

# 2. Change example.com TXT (SPF): "v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com ~all" -> "v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com include:_spf.google.com ~all"
#    Find the record's id, then:
curl -sS "$API?type=TXT&name=example.com" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"
curl -sS -X PATCH "$API/RECORD_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"type":"TXT","name":"example.com","content":"\"v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com include:_spf.google.com ~all\"","ttl":3600}'

# 3. Delete the google._domainkey.example.com TXT (DKIM) records there now (they were not read)
#    Find their ids (none: skip this step), then:
curl -sS "$API?type=TXT&name=google._domainkey.example.com" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"
curl -sS -X DELETE "$API/RECORD_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"

# 4. Add google._domainkey.example.com TXT "v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=MIIBIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAAOCAQ8AMIIBCgKCAQEAexampleexampleexample"
curl -sS -X POST "$API" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"type":"TXT","name":"google._domainkey.example.com","content":"\"v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=MIIBIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAAOCAQ8AMIIBCgKCAQEAexampleexampleexample\"","ttl":3600}'

## octodns
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# In the zone's YAML (example.com.yaml): set these entries; the other names stay as they are.
# TXT values write ; as \; : the YamlProvider needs escaped_semicolons: true (octoDNS refuses them with false, its default from 2.0).
---
'':
  - ttl: 3600
    type: MX
    values:
      - exchange: smtp.google.com.
        preference: 1
  - ttl: 3600
    type: TXT
    values:
      - 'google-site-verification=abc123'
      - 'v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com include:_spf.google.com ~all'
google._domainkey:
  # keep the other TXT values this name has; replace its DKIM value with the one below
  - ttl: 3600
    type: TXT
    values:
      - 'v=DKIM1\; k=rsa\; p=MIIBIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAAOCAQ8AMIIBCgKCAQEAexampleexampleexample'

## terraform-cloudflare
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# terraform-provider-cloudflare v4 (cloudflare_record; v5 names it cloudflare_dns_record).
variable "cloudflare_zone_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "The zone ID of example.com"
}

# change: the resource that holds example.com MX 10 mail.example.com. gets the value below

resource "cloudflare_record" "mx_apex" {
  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name     = "example.com"
  type     = "MX"
  content  = "smtp.google.com"
  priority = 1
  ttl      = 3600
}

# change: the resource that holds example.com TXT "v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com ~all" gets the value below

resource "cloudflare_record" "txt_apex" {
  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name     = "example.com"
  type     = "TXT"
  content  = "v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com include:_spf.google.com ~all"
  ttl      = 3600
}

# remove the resources of any other google._domainkey.example.com TXT (DKIM) record (the current ones were not read)

resource "cloudflare_record" "txt_google_domainkey" {
  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name     = "google._domainkey.example.com"
  type     = "TXT"
  content  = "v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=MIIBIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAAOCAQ8AMIIBCgKCAQEAexampleexampleexample"
  ttl      = 3600
}
## terraform-route53
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# aws_route53_record manages a whole record set: every value of the name and type is listed.
variable "route53_zone_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "The hosted zone ID of example.com"
}

resource "aws_route53_record" "mx_apex" {
  zone_id = var.route53_zone_id
  name    = "example.com"
  type    = "MX"
  ttl     = 3600
  records = ["1 smtp.google.com"]
}

resource "aws_route53_record" "txt_apex" {
  zone_id = var.route53_zone_id
  name    = "example.com"
  type    = "TXT"
  ttl     = 3600
  records = ["google-site-verification=abc123", "v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com include:_spf.google.com ~all"]
}

# list the other TXT values of google._domainkey.example.com here too (they were not read): this resource replaces the whole set

resource "aws_route53_record" "txt_google_domainkey" {
  zone_id = var.route53_zone_id
  name    = "google._domainkey.example.com"
  type    = "TXT"
  ttl     = 3600
  records = ["v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=MIIBIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAAOCAQ8AMIIBCgKCAQEAexampleexampleexample"]
}

## en
DNS change request: example.com

Please make the following changes in the DNS zone example.com. Records not listed here stay as they are.

1. Replace: MX records
   Name: example.com
   Value:
     1 smtp.google.com.
   TTL: 3600
   This removes:
     10 mail.example.com.
2. Replace: SPF record (TXT)
   Name: example.com
   Value:
     "v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com include:_spf.google.com ~all"
   TTL: 3600
   This removes:
     "v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com ~all"
   The other TXT records of the name stay as they are.
3. Replace: DKIM record (TXT)
   Name: google._domainkey.example.com
   Value:
     "v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=MIIBIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAAOCAQ8AMIIBCgKCAQEAexampleexampleexample"
   TTL: 3600
   Replace the name’s DKIM record with the value above.
   The other TXT records of the name stay as they are.

Notes:
- smtp.google.com with priority 1 is Google’s current single MX; the older five aspmx records keep working.
- _dmarc.example.com already has a DMARC record; it stays as it is.

Once the change is made, this link shows whether public DNS resolvers see it:
https://example.github.io/domainscope/#/change/check?z=example.com&r=is+@+MX+1+smtp.google.com.%5E10+mail.example.com.&r=is+@+TXT+%22v=spf1+include:spf.protection.outlook.com+include:_spf.google.com+~all%22%5E%22v=spf1+include:spf.protection.outlook.com+~all%22&r=is+google._domainkey+TXT+%22v=DKIM1;+k=rsa;+p=MIIBIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAAOCAQ8AMIIBCgKCAQEAexampleexampleexample%22
## tr
DNS değişiklik talebi: example.com

Lütfen example.com DNS zone’unda aşağıdaki değişiklikleri yapın. Burada yer almayan kayıtlar olduğu gibi kalır.

1. Değiştir: MX kayıtları
   Ad: example.com
   Değer:
     1 smtp.google.com.
   TTL: 3600
   Bu değişiklikle kaldırılanlar:
     10 mail.example.com.
2. Değiştir: SPF kaydı (TXT)
   Ad: example.com
   Değer:
     "v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com include:_spf.google.com ~all"
   TTL: 3600
   Bu değişiklikle kaldırılanlar:
     "v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com ~all"
   Adın diğer TXT kayıtları olduğu gibi kalır.
3. Değiştir: DKIM kaydı (TXT)
   Ad: google._domainkey.example.com
   Değer:
     "v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=MIIBIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAAOCAQ8AMIIBCgKCAQEAexampleexampleexample"
   TTL: 3600
   Adın DKIM kaydını yukarıdaki değerle değiştirin.
   Adın diğer TXT kayıtları olduğu gibi kalır.

Notlar:
- Öncelik 1 ile smtp.google.com, Google’ın güncel tek MX kaydıdır; eski beş aspmx kaydı da çalışmaya devam eder.
- _dmarc.example.com adında zaten bir DMARC kaydı var; olduğu gibi kalır.

Değişiklik yapıldıktan sonra genel DNS çözümleyicilerinin onu görüp görmediğini bu bağlantı gösterir:
https://example.github.io/domainscope/#/change/check?z=example.com&r=is+@+MX+1+smtp.google.com.%5E10+mail.example.com.&r=is+@+TXT+%22v=spf1+include:spf.protection.outlook.com+include:_spf.google.com+~all%22%5E%22v=spf1+include:spf.protection.outlook.com+~all%22&r=is+google._domainkey+TXT+%22v=DKIM1;+k=rsa;+p=MIIBIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAAOCAQ8AMIIBCgKCAQEAexampleexampleexample%22
